**Conclusion:**
While the company displays positive revenue growth and improved profitability (Net Income), the rise in Liabilities and COGS requires careful monitoring. The overall improvement in financial ratios and key performance indicators (KPIs) leans towards a slightly negative sentiment. The growth in Sales and EPS and increase in equity are positives, however the continued expenses are concerning.
